description.value: A cross-sectional fMRI study comparing whole-brain neural activation during personalized guided-imagery conditions in smokers and non-smokers.

value: we hypothesized that smokers as compared to non-smokers would exhibit decreased neural response to favorite-food cues in corticostriatal-limbic regions.

name.value: smokers relative to non-smokers during favorite-food cue exposure

definition.value: Smokers relative to non-smokers demonstrated diminished neural activation during exposure to favorite-food cues.

value: Smokers versus non-smokers exhibited relatively blunted corticostriatal-limbic activations to favorite-food cues.
The identified differences in neural responses to favorite-food cues in smokers may contribute to their relatively lower BMIs.
